cues.en: This chapter is all about how you can download files, and in order to do this, you will learn how
to use the program wget to download files even if you know curl for certain download operations.
Wget is just way more convenient and way easier to use.
In addition, it allows us certain types of downloads that would not be possible with curl.
In addition, you will learn about checksums and how they can help you to verify your download to see
whether all everything has worked properly or you might have to redownload a specific file.
This is very important if you, for example, want to download an image or a Linux distribution or software
or anything to your computer with a with a checksum, you are then able to verify whether everything
has worked properly and you can actually trust the download that you just did.
Let's now have a look at the program wget and let's have a look at that in the next lecture.
